content.text: Travis keeps failing, and so I'm re-opening this. It can be dealt with post 4.5.1 release.
Travis must just be having a bad day. I can't reproduce its failures locally, it doesn't like the reversion of this and jenkins is fine either way, so I'm going to close this issue for now.
Sounds reasonable. Both the master and reverted commits build locally here as well.
I suspect it has something to do with either the travis configuration or the maven-surefire plugin config. I bet adding something like: <argLine>-Xmx1024m</argLine> will do the trick.
I had a problem building this inside the vagrant VM once. It ran out of memory. Just an FYI.

. That's exactly why I think the problem is with the maven configuration. I'm fiddling with it now, but it's a trial-and-error sort of thing, and you don't find out if it worked until 20 minutes pass.
Thanks all-- that last pr seemed to fix the Travis issue
